ns2:course.label: Intro to Psycholinguistics
ns2:course.description: (LING 325) Introductory survey of psychological and linguistic approaches to the study of communication. Same as COMM 425. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Credit is not given for both LING 425 and PSYC 425. Prerequisite: An introductory course in linguistics or psychology
